justification: Inspected byte-buddy-agent/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/agent/VirtualMachine.java:2026-2103, 2108-2561, and 2561-2705 plus byte-buddy-agent/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/agent/VirtualMachineForOpenJ9Test.java. Dispatcher is a small 8-method interface for OpenJ9 native operations, and the file already decomposes the work into separate POSIX and Windows implementations (ForJnaPosixEnvironment and ForJnaWindowsEnvironment) with platform-specific helpers, so the responsibilities are split rather than concentrated in one under-modularized class.
